title: A planted check counts numbered markers by whole tokens, never by substring
goal: the sprint skill's plan step 6 tells the planner that a planted check counting numbered markers in output (line0, line1 ... line29) counts whole tokens (a word boundary), since a substring count reads line2 in line28

run:
import re,sys
t=open('skills/sprint/SKILL.md',encoding='utf-8').read()
s=t.split('## plan',1)[1].split('\n## ',1)[0]
step=[p for p in re.split(r'\n(?=\d+\. )',s) if p.startswith('6. ')]
sys.exit(0 if step and re.search(r'whole[- ]token|whole number|word boundar',step[0],re.I) else 1)

notes: SP-7ba3r4ec close: BG-lclivroa's repro counted 'small%d' by substring, so small2 matched small28 and small29 and a correct fix could not pass; its worker stopped on a gate and the operator approved the rewrite.
